title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: This Master Services Agreement is entered into between Northwind Analytics Ltd (the Provider) and Acme Retail S.A. (the Client). The Provider shall deliver demand-forecasting analytics, data pipeline operation and a hosted reporting platform as described in each Statement of Work.

title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: The initial term of this Agreement is thirty-six (36) months starting on 1 March 2025. After the initial term, the Agreement renews automatically for successive renewal periods of twelve (12) months unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.

title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: The Client shall pay the Provider a fixed monthly fee of USD 48,000 (forty-eight thousand United States dollars). The Provider invoices monthly in arrears and each invoice is payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. All amounts are exclusive of taxes.

title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: Any undisputed amount not paid when due accrues interest at a rate of 1.5% per month, calculated daily from the due date until the date of payment. The Provider may suspend the Services if any undisputed invoice remains unpaid for more than sixty (60) days after written notice.

title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: The Provider shall make the hosted reporting platform available at least 99.5% of each calendar month. For each full 0.5 percentage point of availability below that target, the Client is entitled to a service credit of 5% of the monthly fee for that month. Service credits in any month are capped at 25% of the monthly fee and are the Client's sole remedy for availability failures.

title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: Except for breach of confidentiality, fraud or wilful misconduct, each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement is limited to an amount equal to the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss, including loss of profit.

title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: The Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving the Provider at least sixty (60) days' written notice and paying a termination fee equal to three (3) months of the monthly fee. Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other party commits a material breach that is not remedied within thirty (30) days of being notified of it.

title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: Each party shall keep the other party's Confidential Information secret and use it only to perform this Agreement. These obligations continue for five (5) years after the expiry or termination of this Agreement. Personal data is additionally governed by the Data Processing Addendum.

title: Master Services Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and Acme Retail S.A.
text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales. The courts of London have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or in connection with it, after the parties have attempted in good faith to resolve the dispute through senior management for thirty (30) days.

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and BluePeak Energy Inc.
text: Northwind Analytics Ltd and BluePeak Energy Inc. wish to exchange confidential information to evaluate a potential collaboration on grid-load forecasting (the Purpose). Each party may act as disclosing party and receiving party under this Agreement.

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and BluePeak Energy Inc.
text: This Agreement takes effect on 10 February 2026 and remains in force for two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either party with thirty (30) days' written notice. The receiving party's confidentiality obligations survive for three (3) years after the expiry or termination of this Agreement.

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and BluePeak Energy Inc.
text: Confidential information does not include information that is or becomes public through no fault of the receiving party, was lawfully known to the receiving party before disclosure, is independently developed without use of the disclosing party's information, or is lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidence.

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and BluePeak Energy Inc.
text: Within fifteen (15) days of the disclosing party's written request, the receiving party shall return or destroy all confidential information and certify the destruction in writing, except for copies retained in automatic backups, which remain subject to this Agreement.

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and BluePeak Energy Inc.
text: No licence to any intellectual property is granted by disclosure under this Agreement. Neither party is obliged to enter into any further agreement as a result of the Purpose.

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Northwind Analytics Ltd and BluePeak Energy Inc.
text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, United States, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County.

title: Commercial Lease — Harbor Point Properties Ltda. and Northwind Analytics Brasil Ltda.
text: Harbor Point Properties Ltda. (the Lessor) leases to Northwind Analytics Brasil Ltda. (the Lessee) office space of 1,200 square metres on the 14th floor of the Harbor Point Tower, Avenida Paulista, São Paulo, for use exclusively as offices.

title: Commercial Lease — Harbor Point Properties Ltda. and Northwind Analytics Brasil Ltda.
text: The lease term is sixty (60) months starting on 1 January 2024. The lease does not renew automatically; any renewal requires a written amendment signed by both parties at least one hundred and eighty (180) days before the end of the term.

title: Commercial Lease — Harbor Point Properties Ltda. and Northwind Analytics Brasil Ltda.
text: The monthly rent is BRL 85,000 (eighty-five thousand reais), payable by the fifth business day of each month. The rent is adjusted every twelve (12) months by the accumulated variation of the IPCA index for the preceding period.

title: Commercial Lease — Harbor Point Properties Ltda. and Northwind Analytics Brasil Ltda.
text: On signature, the Lessee shall provide a security deposit equal to three (3) months of rent, which the Lessor returns, adjusted by the savings-account index, within thirty (30) days after the premises are returned in the agreed condition.

title: Commercial Lease — Harbor Point Properties Ltda. and Northwind Analytics Brasil Ltda.
text: The Lessee may terminate the lease before the end of the term with ninety (90) days' written notice, paying a penalty equal to three (3) months of the current rent, reduced in proportion to the part of the lease term already elapsed.

title: Commercial Lease — Harbor Point Properties Ltda. and Northwind Analytics Brasil Ltda.
text: The Lessee is responsible for routine maintenance and repairs inside the premises. The Lessor is responsible for structural repairs, the building's facade and roof, and the central air-conditioning plant.

title: Commercial Lease — Harbor Point Properties Ltda. and Northwind Analytics Brasil Ltda.
text: This lease is governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil, in particular Law 8,245/1991. The courts of the city of São Paulo have jurisdiction over any dispute.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: Orion Components Inc. (the Supplier) shall manufacture and supply to Northwind Analytics Ltd (the Buyer) model OR-7 industrial IoT sensors meeting the specifications in Schedule A.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: This Agreement starts on 15 July 2025 and continues for three (3) years. It may be extended only by mutual written agreement of the parties; there is no automatic renewal.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: The unit price of each OR-7 sensor is USD 112, fixed for the first twelve (12) months. Thereafter the Supplier may adjust prices once per contract year with sixty (60) days' notice, by no more than 4% per adjustment.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: The Buyer commits to purchase a minimum of 20,000 units in each contract year. If the Buyer purchases fewer units, the parties shall meet within thirty (30) days to agree on revised forecasts.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: The Buyer places purchase orders through the Supplier's portal. The Supplier shall deliver each order within forty-five (45) days of accepting the purchase order, DAP at the Buyer's warehouse in Rotterdam.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: The Supplier warrants that each sensor is free from defects in materials and workmanship for twenty-four (24) months from delivery. The Supplier shall repair or replace defective units at its own cost within fifteen (15) business days of a warranty claim.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: The Buyer may inspect the Supplier's manufacturing facilities and quality records once per contract year, giving at least ten (10) business days' prior written notice.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: Each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to USD 2,000,000 (two million United States dollars), except for liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud.

title: Supply Agreement — Orion Components Inc. and Northwind Analytics Ltd
text: Neither party is liable for delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, provided it notifies the other party within five (5) days. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, United States.

title: Data Processing Addendum — Acme Retail S.A. (Controller) and Northwind Analytics Ltd (Processor)
text: This Addendum supplements the Master Services Agreement. Acme Retail S.A. acts as Controller and Northwind Analytics Ltd acts as Processor of customer purchase histories and loyalty-programme data processed to provide the Services.

title: Data Processing Addendum — Acme Retail S.A. (Controller) and Northwind Analytics Ltd (Processor)
text: The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay and in any event within forty-eight (48) hours after becoming aware of a personal data breach, providing the information available at that time.

title: Data Processing Addendum — Acme Retail S.A. (Controller) and Northwind Analytics Ltd (Processor)
text: The Processor may engage sub-processors only after giving the Controller at least thirty (30) days' written notice. The Controller may object on reasonable data-protection grounds during that period.

title: Data Processing Addendum — Acme Retail S.A. (Controller) and Northwind Analytics Ltd (Processor)
text: Within sixty (60) days after the end of the Services, the Processor shall, at the Controller's choice, delete or return all personal data and delete existing copies, unless retention is required by law.

title: Data Processing Addendum — Acme Retail S.A. (Controller) and Northwind Analytics Ltd (Processor)
text: The Controller may audit the Processor's compliance with this Addendum once per calendar year, giving at least thirty (30) days' written notice, during normal business hours and at the Controller's own cost.

title: Data Processing Addendum — Acme Retail S.A. (Controller) and Northwind Analytics Ltd (Processor)
text: Personal data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area only under the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or another lawful transfer mechanism.
